# Active Oahu Tours & Activities

> Active Oahu Tours is a locally owned, eco-conscious tour operator based in Kailua on the island of Oahu, Hawaii. We offer guided and self-guided kayak tours to the Mokulua Islands (Kailua's Twin Islands), Chinaman's Hat (Mokoliʻi), and the Kāneʻohe Bay Sandbar; e-bike adventures through Kailua and the North Shore; stand-up paddleboard lessons and rentals; self-guided snorkel experiences at Sharks Cove and Lanikai; and beach gear rentals. All tours depart from Kailua with convenient pickup. Booking is handled by FareHarbor (company shortname `activeoahutours`); every tour page includes a live booking widget with real-time availability.

Service area: Windward Oahu (Kailua, Lanikai, Kāneʻohe) and the North Shore (Haleʻiwa, Sharks Cove). Established 2009. Tripadvisor Travelers' Choice award winner (2022).

## Guided Kayak Tours

- [Mokulua Islands Guided Kayak Tour — Kailua's Twin Islands](https://activeoahutours.com/activities/kailua-kayak-twin-islands-guided-tour/): ~5 hours. Paddle from Kailua Beach Park across the bay to the Mokulua Islands, a protected bird sanctuary. Includes safety briefing, all gear, snorkeling, and a beach stop. Beginner-friendly. FareHarbor flow `1128101`.
- [Mokoliʻi (Chinaman's Hat) Kayak Tour](https://activeoahutours.com/activities/chinamans-hat-oahu-kayak-tours/): Cross Kāneʻohe Bay to the iconic Mokoliʻi islet. Optional short hike to the summit. Includes gear, dry bag, and local guide.
- [Popoia Island & Kailua Bay Guided Kayak Tour](https://activeoahutours.com/activities/popoia-island-and-kailua-bay-guided-kayak-tour/): Visit Flat Island (Popoia) and learn about its wildlife sanctuary status. Shorter paddle, good for families. FareHarbor flow `1128101`.
- [Mokulua Islands Kayak Tour & E-Bike Adventure (Combo)](https://activeoahutours.com/activities/guided-mokulua-islands-kayak-tour-and-e-bike-adventure/): Half-day kayak to the Mokes plus an afternoon e-bike loop around Kailua. FareHarbor flows `1128101`, `1038571`.
- [Kailua Twin Islands Guided Kayak Tour](https://activeoahutours.com/activities/kailua-flat-island-popoia-island-guided-kayak-e-bike-adventure/): Guided paddle to both Popoia and the Mokulua Islands with snorkeling and lunch on the beach. FareHarbor flow `1133442`.

## Self-Guided Kayak Tours & Rentals

- [Kailua Bay & Mokulua Islands Self-Guided Kayak Tour](https://activeoahutours.com/activities/kailua-bay-mokulua-island-self-guided-kayak-tour/): Full-day independent paddle from Kailua Beach to the Mokes. Includes kayak, life vest, dry bag, map, and safety briefing. FareHarbor flow `1038571`.
- [Chinaman's Hat Self-Guided Kayak Tour](https://activeoahutours.com/activities/chinamans-hat-self-guided-oahu-kayak-tour/): Self-guided paddle across Kāneʻohe Bay to Mokoliʻi. Includes round-trip kayak rental with optional island time. FareHarbor flow `1038571`.
- [Kahana Rainforest River Self-Guided Kayak Tour](https://activeoahutours.com/activities/kahana-rainforest-river-oahu-kayak-tour/): Calm river paddle through Kahana Valley rainforest, with optional ocean section to the bay. Family-friendly. FareHarbor flow `1128101`.
- [East Oahu Self-Guided Kayaking Experience](https://activeoahutours.com/activities/east-oahu-self-guided-kayaking-experience/): Independent Kailua-area paddle for experienced kayakers. FareHarbor flow `1038571`.
- [Kāneʻohe Sandbar Kayak Rentals](https://activeoahutours.com/activities/kaneohe-sandbar-kayak-rentals/): Self-guided rental with delivery to Heeia Kea Boat Harbor; paddle to the Kāneʻohe Bay Sandbar.
- [Chinaman's Hat Kayak Rentals](https://activeoahutours.com/activities/chinamans-hat-kayak-rentals/): Independent rental option for experienced paddlers.

## E-Bike Adventures

- [Kailua E-Bike Kau Kau Guided Adventure](https://activeoahutours.com/activities/kailua-e-bike-kau-kau-guided-adventure/): Food-focused guided e-bike tour of Kailua town — local cafes, food trucks, and landmarks. FareHarbor flow `1133442`.
- [Aloha ʻĀina E-Bike Adventure](https://activeoahutours.com/activities/aloha-aina-e-bike-adventure/): Self-paced e-bike rental exploring Kailua, Lanikai, and the surrounding neighborhoods. FareHarbor flow `1133442`.
- [Lanikai Beach Self-Guided E-Bike & Snorkel Adventure](https://activeoahutours.com/activities/lanikai-beach-self-guided-e-bike-snorkel-adventure/): Self-guided e-bike to Lanikai Beach plus snorkel gear for the Mokulua swim area.

## Snorkel Experiences

- [Sharks Cove Self-Guided Snorkel](https://activeoahutours.com/activities/sharks-cove-self-guided-snorkel/): North Shore summer snorkel (Jun–Sep). Premium gear, defog, dry bag, and local tips for Pupukea tide pools included.
- [West Oahu Guided Snorkel Tour](https://activeoahutours.com/activities/west-oahu-guided-snorkel-tour/): Boat-assisted snorkel on the leeward coast.

## Paddleboard (SUP)

- [Haleʻiwa Paddleboarding](https://activeoahutours.com/activities/haleiwa-paddleboarding/): SUP lessons on the Haleʻiwa River; also offers night Glow SUP tours.
- [Rainforest Oahu Stand-Up Paddleboarding](https://activeoahutours.com/activities/rainforest-oahu-stand-up-paddle-boarding/): Calm river SUP in Kahana Valley.

## Surf & Wellness

- [Oahu Surf Lessons](https://activeoahutours.com/activities/oahu-surf-lessons/): Beginner-friendly surf lessons on the North Shore (seasonal) and Waikiki. FareHarbor flow `1038571`.
- [Destination Yoga](https://activeoahutours.com/activities/destination-yoga/): Outdoor yoga sessions in scenic Oahu locations.
- [Rainforest Guided Hike](https://activeoahutours.com/activities/rainforest-guided-hike/): Easy-moderate guided hike through Kahana Valley. FareHarbor flow `1038571`.

## Booking & Practical Info

- [How to Book](https://fareharbor.com/embeds/book/activeoahutours/): All tours and rentals are booked through FareHarbor. The booking widgets on tour pages show real-time availability and accept credit card payment.
- FareHarbor company shortname: `activeoahutours`. Direct embed base: `https://fareharbor.com/embeds/book/activeoahutours/`.
- Cancellation policy: full refund with 24+ hours notice; weather-related cancellations refunded or rescheduled.
- Meeting location: most tours depart from the Active Oahu storefront in Kailua (134B Hamakua Dr). Self-guided rentals include optional pickup from Waikiki hotels.
- Languages: English; some tours available with Japanese-speaking guides on request.
- Group sizes: 2–12 for guided tours; private tours available.

## Locations

- Kailua Bay & Beach Park — primary departure point for kayak and SUP tours
- Lanikai Beach — snorkel, e-bike, kayak
- Mokulua Islands (Na Mokulua, "the Mokes") — bird sanctuary, kayak destination
- Mokoliʻi (Chinaman's Hat) — Kāneʻohe Bay kayak destination
- Kāneʻohe Bay Sandbar — shallow sandbar, kayak and SUP
- Kahana Valley / Kahana River — rainforest river paddle
- North Shore: Haleʻiwa, Sharks Cove, Sunset Beach, Waimea Bay
- Popoia Island (Flat Island) — kayak stop between Kailua and the Mokes
